title: Signed-power transport from positive comparisons
statement: Let g:X→Y be a scheme isomorphism, R and S commutative ring sheaves and c:g⁻¹R≅S. Let M and N be module sheaves and fix, for each d≥0, P_d:F_g(M^tensor d)≅N^tensor d [def-pur-twist-sheaves, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product, def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. For a positive integer d define degree -d by internal Hom from degree d to the coefficient unit. There exists a unique family tau_m:F_g(M(m))≅N(m), for m in Z, agreeing with P at all nonnegative integers and satisfying the evaluation equation on every slice: tau_(-d)(eta phi) evaluated at P_d(eta x) equals P_0(eta(phi(x))), after every site restriction. No local freeness or invertibility-of-l hypothesis is used.

proof.text: The module pullback unit at a scheme isomorphism is invertible and its direct image reflects isomorphisms. The canonical internal Hom comparison is therefore invertible. Its section normalization transports evaluation after arbitrary slice restriction.

proof.text: For degree -d compose the internal Hom comparison with precomposition by the inverse P_d and postcomposition by P_0. Inverse cancellation gives the evaluation equation. For uniqueness apply the module adjunction and slice-Hom extensionality; the invertible P_d and unit permit cancellation. Define the family by the disjoint nonnegative/negative integer cases.

mathlib_searches.query: Inverse image along an isomorphism of ringed sites extends the canonical inverse limit of roots of unity to integral and finite coefficient Tate lines
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits, including Scheme.inv_app and stalk isomorphism lemmas; none states the root-limit coefficient comparison. A second query on maps from sheafified tensor powers returns SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections and sheafification maps, which do not establish generation by these root tensors.

TensorProduct.ext in Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.TensorProduct.Basic supplies ordinary tensor extensionality. It does not state sheafified root-power generation or normalized inverse-image maps. Earlier SheafOfModules, _ ≅ _ query returned general module isomorphisms only.

msearch Mathlib grep: zero hits. Local library search finds the normalized signed-line API and integral tensor transport, but they require local freeness or invertibility of l; the present original theorem assumes only that g is an isomorphism. The canonical ordinary tensor pullback theorem is already proved and is used for power induction. Blueprint searches for root tensor, generator-normalized, internal Hom comparison and 03EL found no identical node.

lean.statement:
theorem genericSignedProof {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology Y) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (S : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage g CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj R ≅ S)
    (M : proEtaleRingModules Y R) (N : proEtaleRingModules X S)
    (P : ∀ d : ℕ, (proEtaleRingModulePullback g R S c).obj
      (coefficientTwistPower Y (R := R) M d) ≅ coefficientTwistPower X (R := S) N d) :
    ∃! tau : ∀ m : ℤ, (proEtaleRingModulePullback g R S c).obj
        (coefficientTwistLine Y (R := R) M m) ≅ coefficientTwistLine X (R := S) N m,
      (∀ d : ℕ, HEq (tau (d : ℤ)) (P d)) ∧
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (V W : Y.ProEt) (a : W ⟶ V)
        (phi : (coefficientTwistLine Y (R := R) M (Int.negSucc n)).val.obj (op V))
        (x : (coefficientTwistPower Y (R := R) M (n + 1)).val.obj (op W)),
        ((tau (Int.negSucc n)).hom.val.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V))
          (((proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction g R S c).unit.app _).val.app (op V) phi)).app
            (op (Over.mk ((proEtaleBaseChange g).map a)))
              ((P (n + 1)).hom.val.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj W))
                (((proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction g R S c).unit.app _).val.app (op W) x)) =
          (P 0).hom.val.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj W))
            (((proEtaleRingModuleAdjunction g R S c).unit.app _).val.app (op W)
              (phi.app (op (Over.mk a)) x))
